status: crew study proposal (Orion Crest look, rig v2); not published; not owner-approved

frames.blender: metres, Z up, character faces +Y, +X = character's right
frames.gltf: Y up, character faces -Z, +X = character's right (gltf = (x, z, -y))
frames.items: item space: origin at the primary grip centre, forward -Z (glTF) / +Y (Blender), up +Y (glTF) / +Z (Blender); attach item.<id> to prop.R / prop.L with an IDENTITY local transform

materials.recolour: baseColorFactor (Babylon albedoColor / Godot albedo_color); COLOR_0 is greyscale shade; Godot: vertex_color_use_as_albedo = true

regionRules.head_low: scalp-less head (z 39..50.0 vox): shown INSTEAD of head when a worn part covers 'scalp' (voluminous hair, see parts.<id>.covers_by_mode); hidden otherwise
regionRules.head: hidden (with head_low) when a worn part covers 'head' (sealed helmets)
regionRules.hands: hidden when a worn part covers 'hands'
regionRules.base: triangles of bones whose region is covered are hidden (rig.REGION_OF_BONE)

hair.swept.label: Swept
hair.swept.notes: Base-rig male: voluminous purple locks swept forward and to the character's right; stepped pointed fringe locks, temple locks, tiered sides.

hair.short_side.label: Short side-swept
hair.short_side.notes: Captain M: short dark navy hair, side part on the character's left, swept right.

hair.crop.label: Crop
hair.crop.notes: Short even crop that sits under hard hats and helmets.

hair.spiky.label: Spiky
hair.spiky.notes: Security M: short sides, stepped tufts on the crown leaning outward.

hair.tousled.label: Tousled
hair.tousled.notes: Mechanic M: lilac-grey messy short hair, ragged locks stepping in and out.

hair.fluffy_curls.label: Fluffy curls
hair.fluffy_curls.notes: Scientist M: big round mass of compact purple curl clusters over the ears, curls framing the face.

hair.long_curls.label: Long curls
hair.long_curls.notes: Captain F: long brown zig-zag curls to mid-back, centre part, curls framing the face.

hair.messy_bun.label: Messy bun
hair.messy_bun.notes: Engineer F: brown hair gathered into a big lumpy bun at the back of the crown, loose strands.

hair.bun.label: Gathered bun
hair.bun.notes: Medic F: black hair gathered into a round bun at the back of the crown, shoulder-length waves at the back, locks framing the face. Nurse cap seat: NURSE_CAP_SEAT (crown in front of the bun).

hair.high_ponytail.label: High ponytail
hair.high_ponytail.notes: Pilot F / base-rig F: big high ponytail gathered at the crown-back, arcing back and down to the upper back toward the character's right (reads behind the head in the 3/4 card view); swept fringe, face-framing locks.

hair.long_ponytail.label: Long ponytail
hair.long_ponytail.notes: Mechanic F: long blonde ponytail from the back of the head (through a cap opening), hanging to mid-back toward the character's right; face-framing strands.

hair.braids.label: Box braids
hair.braids.notes: Security F: compact curly crown and long separated box braids round the back and sides.

hair.long_wavy.label: Long wavy ponytail
hair.long_wavy.notes: Marine F: voluminous red hair, side-swept fringe, long locks framing the face and a big loose wavy ponytail flowing behind to mid-back.

hair.short_bob.label: Short bob
hair.short_bob.notes: Salvage F: short dark bob to the jaw with straight bangs (sits under a hard hat).

hair.shoulder_wavy.label: Shoulder waves
hair.shoulder_wavy.notes: Scout F: teal wavy hair to the shoulders, waves framing the face (visible under caps / harness).

hair.twin_puffs.label: Twin puffs
hair.twin_puffs.notes: Scientist F: a compact round dome with two round curly puffs on top (covers the scalp in mode full: worn over body.head_low), wavy curls framing the face to the chin.

hair.buzz.label: Buzz cut
hair.buzz.notes: Very short even buzz: one close layer, darker value (shaved read).

hair.side_part.label: Side part
hair.side_part.notes: Neat side part on the character's left, combed over to the right.

hair.crest.label: Crest
hair.crest.notes: Tall stepped crest (mohawk) front to back over shaved sides.

hair.afro.label: Afro
hair.afro.notes: Big rounded afro of compact curl clusters.

hair.pixie.label: Pixie
hair.pixie.notes: Short feminine pixie: swept fringe with pointed locks, wispy sideburns, short nape.

hair.twin_tails.label: Twin tails
hair.twin_tails.notes: Two high side tails hanging behind the shoulders, swept fringe.

hair.long_straight.label: Long straight
hair.long_straight.notes: Straight long hair to mid-back, centre part, face-framing curtains.

hair.slick_back.label: Slicked back
hair.slick_back.notes: Hair combed straight back from the forehead, no fringe.

hair.undercut.label: Undercut
hair.undercut.notes: Shaved sides and back under a long top swept over to the character's right.

facial.stubble.label: Stubble
facial.stubble.notes: Dark skin-band blocks (hair slot, shade 0.55). Uses the hair-slot colour (pass the scalp hair colour); build() returns [] in mode 'hidden'.

facial.short.label: Short beard
facial.short.notes: Uses the hair-slot colour (pass the scalp hair colour); build() returns [] in mode 'hidden'.

facial.full.label: Full beard
facial.full.notes: Uses the hair-slot colour (pass the scalp hair colour); build() returns [] in mode 'hidden'.

facial.goatee.label: Goatee
facial.goatee.notes: Uses the hair-slot colour (pass the scalp hair colour); build() returns [] in mode 'hidden'.

facial.moustache.label: Moustache
facial.moustache.notes: Uses the hair-slot colour (pass the scalp hair colour); build() returns [] in mode 'hidden'.

facial.handlebar.label: Handlebar
facial.handlebar.notes: Uses the hair-slot colour (pass the scalp hair colour); build() returns [] in mode 'hidden'.

facial.sideburns.label: Sideburns
facial.sideburns.notes: Uses the hair-slot colour (pass the scalp hair colour); build() returns [] in mode 'hidden'.

facial.chin_strap.label: Chin strap
facial.chin_strap.notes: Uses the hair-slot colour (pass the scalp hair colour); build() returns [] in mode 'hidden'.

facial.soul_patch.label: Soul patch
facial.soul_patch.notes: Uses the hair-slot colour (pass the scalp hair colour); build() returns [] in mode 'hidden'.

uniform.civilian.label: Civilian jumpsuit (T0)
uniform.civilian.notes: male base-rig jumpsuit; stand collar, zip, pocket, badge, shoulder patch, cuffs, front knee pads

uniform.civilian_f.label: Civilian top + trousers (T0, female rig)
uniform.civilian_f.notes: fitted short-sleeve top, dark harness straps, wrist bands, cargo trousers with dark knee pads

uniform.captain.label: Captain coat
uniform.captain.notes: double-breasted navy coat: 1-vox front panels with a stepped V, HALF lapels, white shirt + navy tie, two gold button columns, medal bar, flush gold cuff stripes; straight coat panels below the belt (blended pelvis/thigh) to the hip (wide) / mid-thigh with a centre split (narrow)

uniform.engineer.label: Engineer work suit
uniform.engineer.notes: orange + navy: navy hips and flush side panels, raised orange chest layer with pockets, 1-vox dark harness + chest strap + buckle, navy shoulder patches, lavender cuffs, dark thigh rig, pads

uniform.medic.label: Medic suit
uniform.medic.notes: white suit, flush red yoke / arm / cuff / shin bands, black waist / sides / elbows, chest plate with a red cross, dark harness, black knee pads

uniform.pilot.label: Pilot flight suit
uniform.pilot.notes: white flight suit, flush navy yoke/side panels, blue chest block framed by a 1-vox navy harness, blue collar + cuffs, navy knee pads

uniform.security.label: Security uniform
uniform.security.notes: royal blue with navy yoke/collar/flaps/epaulettes, 1-vox placket and chest pockets, gold badge and buttons, right-arm patch with gold shield, 1-vox white cuff blocks, navy knee pads

uniform.marine.label: Marine undersuit
uniform.marine.notes: slim (<= +0.8 vox) charcoal undersuit with black joints and red stripes; heavy plates come from the armour lane

uniform.salvage.label: Salvage work suit
uniform.salvage.notes: navy torso with orange front panel + shoulders, dark straps, orange legs with grey knee patches and navy bands

uniform.scout.label: Scout camo fatigues
uniform.scout.notes: olive top with three-tone camo patches and a chest pouch row, grey trousers with olive camo, cargo pouches, dark knee pads

uniform.scientist.label: Scientist lab coat
uniform.scientist.notes: open white lab coat over a blue shirt: 1-vox front panels, HALF lapels, breast pocket with pens; wide: short jacket to the hip over white trousers; narrow: long coat to the knees over dark-blue trousers (straight skirt panels, blended pelvis/thigh)

uniform.mechanic.label: Mechanic jumpsuit / overalls
uniform.mechanic.notes: wide: navy-purple jumpsuit, lilac sleeves with orange cuffs, orange collar/flaps/knee pads, patch LED; narrow: orange (#E88A24) bib overalls with dark straps over a navy top, orange short sleeves (bare forearms), orange legs; both: hip tool case

headwear.captain_cap.label: Captain's peaked cap
headwear.captain_cap.notes: Also the armour-tier T0 helmet. voxshape: compact band z 50..52.5 (faces |x|,|y| 11.25), puffy crown 27.5 wide (1-2 steps of overhang) with a raised front saddle; one-step peak z 48.75..50 to y 13.75.

headwear.hardhat_lamp.label: Engineer hard hat with lamp
headwear.hardhat_lamp.notes: Fitted technical helmet: stepped sphere (sealed-shell step), face open below the brow (z < 48.75), sides down to z 42.5 over the ears, neck guard to z 40, ear housings to x +-13.75, lamp; hair in fringe mode (side locks frame the face); visor.goggles_blue seats across its lower front edge.

headwear.medic_helmet.label: Medic sealed helmet
headwear.medic_helmet.notes: Sealed: covers head (the body's head region is hidden). stepped-sphere shell; a cylindrical wrap visor (vertical glass per column, one step behind the shell's front, curving round the front in plan) behind a one-cell rim; two-band rounded chin; near-black navy glass with a few lighter reflection cells; shared visor finish; visor wraps +-52 deg, z 41.25..51.25, dim glowing rim; neck ring at the collar (z 37.5).

headwear.nurse_cap.label: Nurse cap
headwear.nurse_cap.notes: Broad shallow medical tab (12.5 wide, uniform width, no pedestal) sunk two rows into the front crown in front of hair.bun (hair top measured from cr.hair; fallback cr.hair.NURSE_CAP_SEAT); ~3 rows show; whole red cross on its front.

headwear.pilot_helmet.label: Pilot flight helmet
headwear.pilot_helmet.notes: Sealed: covers head. Taller crown than the medic's; stepped-sphere shell; a cylindrical wrap visor (vertical glass per column, one step behind the shell's front, curving round the front in plan) behind a one-cell rim; two-band rounded chin; near-black navy glass with a few lighter reflection cells; shared visor finish; visor wraps +-55 deg, z 42.5..52.5, thin white rim.

headwear.police_cap.label: Security police cap
headwear.police_cap.notes: voxshape: band z 50..52.5, flat square cushion crown, one-step peak.

headwear.eva_helmet.label: Salvage EVA helmet
headwear.eva_helmet.notes: Sealed: covers head. The biggest, roundest sphere (24.2 wide, exponent 2.5 vs 2.6); visor wraps +-50 deg, z 41.25..53.75; visor; lateral housings project two steps (30 wide over them).

headwear.salvage_hardhat.label: Salvage cap
headwear.salvage_hardhat.notes: Compact cap (id kept for roles.py): band z 50..52.5, round one-step crown to z 58.75, short navy bill to y 15; painted yellow / navy / white; visor.goggles_teal sits on its front.

headwear.nv_helmet.label: Scout NV helmet
headwear.nv_helmet.notes: Open lower face (pair with acc.balaclava); NV tubes 4 steps deep with lenses inset one step.

headwear.mechanic_cap.label: Mechanic baseball cap
headwear.mechanic_cap.notes: wide = mechanic M (striped crown, glow-strip peak); narrow = mechanic F (shallower plain crown with a front patch and a rear ponytail opening). acc.headset_orange's band runs inside the crown.

visor.goggles_blue.label: Engineer goggles (blue glow)
visor.goggles_blue.notes: Seated across headwear.hardhat_lamp's lower front edge, the brow (z 48.75..53.75, back in the shell, front two steps proud); lenses recessed one step; strap = the helmet outline grown one step.

visor.goggles_up_orange.label: Engineer goggles pushed up (orange)
visor.goggles_up_orange.notes: On the hair above the fringe (y 8.75..12.5, z 52.5..57.5); luminous cyan lenses (#28DFFF, Codex); the strap is computed one lattice step outside hair.messy_bun's cells (fallback ring if cr.hair is unavailable).

visor.goggles_teal.label: Salvage goggles (teal glow)
visor.goggles_teal.notes: Two separate rounded housings (6.25 x 5 vox, lens 3 x 2 cells) on headwear.salvage_hardhat's (cap's) front above the bill (z 52.5..57.5); strap = the crown outline grown one step.

visor.nv_goggles.label: Scout NV goggles on harness
visor.nv_goggles.notes: The dark harness is a stepped skull-cap from z 50 that crops the hair like a cap; round housings with lenses inset one step.

visor.nv_goggles_strap.label: Scout NV goggles on a strap
visor.nv_goggles_strap.notes: Strap-only variant for scout F (no harness): chunky housings on the top-front of hair.shoulder_wavy (y 8.75..13.75, z 55..60, back pressed into the hair); thin strap one lattice step outside that style's cells at z 57.5..58.75; gold clips join them.

visor.glasses_blue.label: Blue half-rim glasses
visor.glasses_blue.notes: Scientist M: blue half-rim frame along the lower eye line (z 42.1..42.95) with outer side bars and temples; no lens geometry, the pixel eyes read through.

visor.glasses.label: Square glasses
visor.glasses.notes: Thin SMB frame (not voxshape: a one-step frame would cover the pixel eyes); no lens geometry.

acc.balaclava.label: Scout balaclava
acc.balaclava.notes: voxshape mask z 38.75..43.75 under the NV tubes; neck tube to the collar line (neck bone).

acc.scarf_yellow.label: Yellow knit scarf
acc.scarf_yellow.notes: voxshape knit: lumpy wrap on the neck bone; two overlapping descending folds and a hanging end on the chest bone.

acc.scarf_olive.label: Olive knit scarf
acc.scarf_olive.notes: voxshape knit, muted olive #66694B (Codex): lumpy wrap on the neck bone, three overlapping descending folds on the chest bone.

acc.earpiece_medic.label: Medic earpiece
acc.earpiece_medic.notes: Right ear only, x 12.4..14.55 (outside the hair: hair.bun reaches |x| 11.88 at the ear).

acc.headset_blue.label: Pilot headset (blue)
acc.headset_blue.notes: Cups |x| 12.4..14.75 outside the hair (hair.high_ponytail reaches |x| 11.88 at the ear); band arches over the hair (top z 60.25); mic boom on the right.

acc.headset_orange.label: Mechanic headset (orange)
acc.headset_orange.notes: Cups |x| 11.2..12.8 (capped hair.long_ponytail reaches |x| 10.62 there); the band runs inside headwear.mechanic_cap's crown.

armor.helmet.t1.label: Light helmet (T1)
armor.helmet.t1.notes: Orange stepped round dome (terraced superellipsoid), navy goggle band one step proud with twin recessed cyan lenses, closed face (lavender jaw guard with a respirator, as in the reference).

armor.helmet.t2.label: Space helmet (T2)
armor.helmet.t2.notes: White round stepped dome, royal-blue crest stripe, big recessed dark-blue visor (no glowing frame), ear modules with orange LEDs, grey lower rim.

armor.helmet.t3.label: Heavy helmet (T3)
armor.helmet.t3.notes: Broader stepped dome: red crown with toned-down pale stripes, grey brow frame with a small amber lamp, big recessed black visor, charcoal respirator between red cheek plates, big grey side modules with a dark panel and an orange light.

armor.chest.t0.label: Civilian soft top (T0)
armor.chest.t0.notes: One-step lavender top over the uniform: short sleeves, open collar, pocket flaps; the narrow fit adds the reference's gold hem band.

armor.chest.t1.label: Light vest (T1)
armor.chest.t1.notes: One-step lavender vest with navy sides and a one-step-proud wraparound navy harness with orange buckles; side pouch.

armor.chest.t2.label: Armour vest (T2)
armor.chest.t2.notes: One step deeper and wider: royal-blue shell, proud white chest plate, blue yokes, side modules with orange LEDs, white/grey abdomen plates.

armor.chest.t3.label: Heavy chest plate (T3)
armor.chest.t3.notes: A further step deeper and wider: charcoal shell with vented sidewalls, segmented proud red plates, collar opening, big red yokes, bulky side modules; abdomen plates on spine.

armor.shoulders.t0.label: Soft shoulder pad (T0)
armor.shoulders.t0.notes: One soft lavender pad on the left shoulder (off-hand side) with strap and buckle.

armor.shoulders.t1.label: Light pads (T1)
armor.shoulders.t1.notes: White pad on the right shoulder, orange on the left: in the reference 3/4 view the white pad shows its outer face and emblem, i.e. it is the right-shoulder pad (swap the two slot colours to mirror).

armor.shoulders.t2.label: Standard pads (T2)
armor.shoulders.t2.notes: Royal-blue pads one step bigger than T1, white trim band, gold badge on the right.

armor.shoulders.t3.label: Heavy pads (T3)
armor.shoulders.t3.notes: Compact rounded stepped red shells: rounded cap with a pale top stripe and outer insert between dark separations, two lames stepping inward (pale trim), teal screen badge.

armor.shoulders.epaulettes.label: Captain's epaulettes
armor.shoulders.epaulettes.notes: Gold shoulder boards with navy stripes, a fringe block over the outer arm.

armor.back.t0.label: Small pack (T0)
armor.back.t0.notes: Navy body, lavender flap, recessed cyan panel, restrained gold trim, navy pockets frames.

armor.back.t1.label: Cube pack (T1)
armor.back.t1.notes: Orange cube with navy bands and pockets, recessed warm light panel.

armor.back.t2.label: Standard pack (T2)
armor.back.t2.notes: White pack with a proud royal-blue band, gold emblem, blue side housings with LEDs, grey corner blocks, a blue top housing.

armor.back.t3.label: Heavy pack (T3)
armor.back.t3.notes: Charcoal core with separate projecting modules: reactor, side canisters, top module, battery, nozzles; small light strips.

back.command.label: Command pack (captain)
back.command.notes: Slim navy pack with gold piping and crest.

back.engineer.label: Engineer pack
back.engineer.notes: Big navy pack, tall set-back upper unit with glowing blue panels and lights.

back.medic.label: Medic pack
back.medic.notes: White med pack, red cross and side stripes, dark base.

back.pilot.label: Flight pack (pilot)
back.pilot.notes: Rounded navy parachute pack, white edges, harness release.

back.security.label: Security pack
back.security.notes: Navy pack in a dark frame rising (set back) beside the head, gold trim, antenna.

back.salvage.label: Salvage pack
back.salvage.notes: Biggest pack: deep navy body with orange bands, orange side boxes, twin striped tanks rising beside the head.

back.scout.label: Recon pack (scout)
back.scout.notes: Olive pack, dark pouches, recessed green glow strips on both sides.

back.science.label: Science pack
back.science.notes: Dark navy pack, gold side frames, recessed screen, sample tubes.

back.mechanic.label: Mechanic pack
back.mechanic.notes: Navy pack with a big silver open-jaw wrench.

armor.legs.t3.label: Heavy leg armour (T3)
armor.legs.t3.notes: Red thigh plates, grey knee guards with red caps, charcoal outer guards, red shin strips. Partial coverage (front/outer), so it hides no body region.

item.rifle.label: Rifle
item.rifle.notes: left hand wraps the magazine (mag-well hold, ~7 vox ahead: chibi arm reach); role variant item.rifle_security for the security roster

item.shotgun.label: Shotgun
item.shotgun.notes: pistol-grip pump shotgun; the left fist holds the stubby grip under the pump (socket.support rides on part.pump)

item.heavy_gun.label: Heavy gun
item.heavy_gun.notes: loadout tile version with an open lower frame; metal slot = orange end cap / ammo box (plastic family); role variant item.heavy_gun_marine for the heavy marine roster

item.stun_gun.label: Stun gun
item.stun_gun.notes: compact horizontal device: narrow recessed green aperture in a dark bezel, short grip in the body colour

item.wrench.label: Wrench
item.wrench.notes: shaft along +Z through the fist; open ring head (2.2-vox jaw) at +Z, silver ring end with a dark through-opening below the fist; socket.muzzle +Y = item +Z

item.welder.label: Welder
item.welder.notes: part.flame = torch flame (emit), shown while welding (the mechanic's torch)

item.med_kit.label: Med kit
item.med_kit.notes: carried by the top handle (bar along Z through the fist); the case hangs along +Y

item.sample_scanner.label: Sample scanner
item.sample_scanner.notes: tall layered handle (thumb button, no trigger) under an elongated segmented scanning head

item.data_pad.label: Data pad
item.data_pad.notes: portrait-leaning pad (11.6 x 13.2 vox); dark roster casing by default, alt_palettes['loadout'] = the pale loadout-board frame; socket.grip / socket.support sit ON the right / left side edges (x 0 / -11.6) and the screen keeps a 3-vox margin from each, so neither fist covers it; extends to -X; the screen faces -Y (the user; the camera in the pilot's presented hold)

item.drone.label: Drone
item.drone.notes: rounded central body of four substantial stepped tiers, four splayed pods on navy roots grown from the body; held by its launch stem (part.dock, fist under the drone) that retracts into the belly in flight

item.grapple.label: Grapple
item.grapple.notes: compact claw launcher (loadout board): barrel housing with cyan windows, axial barrel, claw head with paired hooked jaws (part.jaw.upper / part.jaw.lower open on fire), compact cable loop under the barrel; the salvage roster uses the role variant item.salvage_claw

item.flashlight.label: Flashlight
item.flashlight.notes: tube along +Z through the fist; socket.light +Y = beam = item +Z

item.shield_pack.label: Shield pack
item.shield_pack.notes: segmented hex field (cyan / blue cells over a dark base); carried by the top handle; worn on the back: attach socket.mount to the character's socket.back

item.holo_tablet.label: Holo tablet
item.holo_tablet.notes: captain navigation display: LEFT-hand tray hold, the slab extends to +X (inward for the left hand); round holographic star chart (dim glass fill, glowing rings / course / waypoints); solid casing margins at both ends for the hands

item.holo_book.label: Holo book
item.holo_book.notes: male scientist reading surface: LEFT-hand hold at the outer cover edge; opens toward +X; broad landscape reading hologram leaning back toward the user (text + molecule diagram)

item.holo_diag.label: Diagnostic panel
item.holo_diag.notes: female medic diagnostic panel: white casing with a red cross, upright portrait hologram (body outline, ECG trace, vitals bars, red cross icon); LEFT-hand tray hold like item.holo_tablet

item.holo_reader.label: Reading tablet
item.holo_reader.notes: female scientist broad reading surface: wide landscape slab and a broad low hologram (text columns + chart) leaning back toward the user; LEFT-hand tray hold like item.holo_tablet

item.scanner_ring.label: Scanner ring
item.scanner_ring.notes: handle along +Z, ring above the fist facing +Y

item.scout_rifle.label: Scout rifle
item.scout_rifle.notes: compact slim receiver; mostly dark shroud with narrow green apertures behind a 1-vox dark rim

item.rifle_security.label: Security rifle
item.rifle_security.notes: role variant of item.rifle (same live item 'rifle'): compact dark carbine for the security roster

item.salvage_claw.label: Salvage claw
item.salvage_claw.notes: role variant of item.grapple (same live item 'grapple') for the salvage roster: hand-held mechanical claw, shaft along +Z through the fist (like the wrench); the jaws open sideways in the item X-Z plane (jaw.upper = +X jaw, jaw.lower = -X jaw, live part names kept), so they read face-on when the knuckles (item +Y) point at the viewer; counterweight ring below; socket.muzzle +Y = item +Z

item.welding_torch.label: Welding torch
item.welding_torch.notes: role variant of item.welder (same live item 'welder') for the mechanic roster: upright torch through the fist (body along +Z like the flashlight), narrow nozzle, stepped flame (part.flame) rising along item +Z; socket.muzzle +Y = item +Z

item.heavy_gun_marine.label: Heavy gun (marine)
item.heavy_gun_marine.notes: role variant of item.heavy_gun (same live item 'heavy-gun'): long slim receiver for the heavy marine roster, carried diagonally

item.smg.label: SMG
item.smg.notes: magazine inserts through the grip; left hand on the vertical foregrip

item.beam_rifle.label: Beam rifle
item.beam_rifle.notes: energy cell rides on top (part.cell lifts out on reload); left hand on the vertical foregrip

item.baton.label: Baton
item.baton.notes: handle along +Z; the energy rod telescopes out of the collar on deploy

item.utility_cutter.label: Utility cutter
item.utility_cutter.notes: handle along +Z; the plasma blade extends from the housing at +Z

item.mining_drill.label: Mining drill
item.mining_drill.notes: left fist on the side handle (bar along Z at x -5.1)

item.scanner.label: Scanner
item.scanner.notes: display on the rear (-Y) face toward the user; socket.sight = display centre facing -Y

item.cargo_box.label: Cargo box
item.cargo_box.notes: right fist on the right side handle, left fist on the left one; box spans x -16..-2

clips.name: shoot_rifle
clips.note: one shot per loop (6 frames = 4 rps); blend over aim_rifle

conventions.prop: prop.R/prop.L joint frame == held item frame (glTF identity attach)
conventions.inPlace: no root motion except ZeroG attitude on root
conventions.events: footstep (side), fire, hit, grab, release, contact, spark, mag_out, mag_in
conventions.supportIK: [first, last] frame ranges where hand.L holds the item's socket.support

hip.R.note: holstered item frame used by the draw/holster clips: item +Y (forward) and +Z (up) in Blender armature axes of the rest pose, origin = socket position + offset; the clip moves prop.R there while holstered

hip.L.note: holstered item frame used by the draw/holster clips: item +Y (forward) and +Z (up) in Blender armature axes of the rest pose, origin = socket position + offset; the clip moves prop.R there while holstered

back.note: holstered item frame used by the draw/holster clips: item +Y (forward) and +Z (up) in Blender armature axes of the rest pose, origin = socket position + offset; the clip moves prop.R there while holstered
